formulas.primary_nominal_rate: D_first_target_complete_primary / (windup+active+recovery), before defense and resource-rest downtime
formulas.magazine: N=floor(magazine/ammo_per_trigger); group_damage=N*D; group_time=N*cycle+reload; sustained_rate=group_damage/group_time; incomplete residue is not a free partial trigger
formulas.defense: reduction=min(0.60,a/(100+a)); received=legal_base*(1-reduction)*(1+vulnerability/100), float internal, no per-pellet ceiling
formulas.piercing: KNF003 only effective_armor=0.75*target_armor for its primary; second-target0.6 only once for SPR002/XBW003
formulas.crit: one draw per AttackID shared all subhits/targets; expected multiplier1+p*(m-1); baseline1.025, caps1.2, expectation not an independent roll per pellet
formulas.action_speed: time=base_time/(1+clamp(action_speed_pct,-20,20)/100); primary/subwindow lower bound0.02s remains; timeline freezes at accepted start
formulas.focus: actual emissions spend; whole trigger must be affordable at start/40% lock; regen after last actual spend delay, no switch refill
formulas.geometry: center hard bounds then exact per-segment shape/height/LOS; projectiles swept versus independent hurtbox; shotgun capsule ray versus hurtbox, one aggregate per target per gun
